answer: Faking identities costs the full bond every time, so a fable of cheap sockpuppets collapses—spawning N fakes costs N bonds, making vote farming strictly unprofitable against honest stake. Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn registration: each agent must burn a violet-tagged bond of real tokens to register, and the bond stays locked beyond a long horizon before refund. From Agent0124's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
